decision.case_state: Ticket NBL-044-invoice-unavailable (Flat 21, 129 Juniper Mews) is at result stage. Landlord Palmer approved the repair (event 012, "Please go ahead", 2025-02-09). Cedar Homes (Noah Ellis) reported the work complete on 2025-02-11 13:22 UTC, but the invoice attachment is unavailable and no amount, visit date or tenant confirmation is on file. Job is on hold for the provider and the tenant.

next_actions.action: Ask Cedar Homes to resend the invoice with the amount including VAT and the visit date.
Ask the tenant to confirm the window opens and closes properly, and to report any remaining fault.
Tell the landlord the work is reported complete, the invoice is awaited, and the tenant check is pending.
Review the job on 2025-02-14 if the invoice or tenant confirmation has not arrived.

boundaries: The contractor's 'complete' message is not yet confirmed by the tenant or a visit record.
Recording the work result does not establish the invoice amount or who pays.
No invoice has been filed, so the job cannot be closed or paid.
The landlord's approval has no spend cap on record, so the cost is unverified against any limit.
remaining_work: Obtain and file the Cedar Homes invoice (provider, owed by agency to landlord account; who_pays to be confirmed).
Get tenant confirmation that the window works.
Confirm correct tenant name and phone number on the record.
Close the job once invoice and tenant confirmation are in and the landlord has been told.
missing_info: Correct tenant name and phone number.
decision.summary: Landlord approved the window handle repair and Cedar Homes reports it complete, but the invoice attachment did not come through and the tenant has not confirmed the fix. I recorded the contractor's completion claim, asked Cedar Homes to resend the invoice, asked the tenant to confirm, informed the landlord, and put the job on hold until 2025-02-14.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: At result stage, on hold for the provider and tenant. Work reported complete by Cedar Homes, but the invoice is unavailable, there is no visit date, and the tenant has not confirmed the fix. Landlord approval was given without a spend cap.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Email Noah Ellis at Cedar Homes to resend the invoice and visit date; email the tenant (existing thread) to confirm the window works; email landlord Palmer with the status. Review on 2025-02-14.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: No decision is needed now. The work is routine and within the landlord's approval. Escalate only if the invoice is disputed or the tenant reports the fault is not fixed.

actions_claimed.description: Recorded contractor-reported completion (outcome completed, evidence event 019) on the ticket.
Emailed Noah Ellis (Cedar Homes) to resend the invoice, amount and visit date.
Emailed the tenant (existing thread, event 007) to confirm the window works.
Emailed landlord Palmer with the status of the job.
Added a note recording the tenant name and phone conflicts and the missing spend cap.
Put the job on hold (Waiting for Provider) with review date 2025-02-14.

conflicts: Tenant name: system records say Nora Quinn (events 014-016); tenant's own emails are signed Harriet (event 007). I addressed the message to both via the existing thread.
Tenant phone: 07700 900307 (events 015, 017) vs 07700 900251 (event 016). I did not phone; messages went by email on the existing thread.
Ticket reference: the contractor and agency references show NBL-044-1849, but the system ticket is NBL-044-invoice-unavailable. I used the system ticket.
Landlord approval (event 012) has no spend cap, so the cost limit is unknown.
assumptions: Event 012 ('Please go ahead') approves the repair at whatever cost the contractor quotes, since no cap was stated.
The contractor's 'complete' statement is accepted as provisional until the tenant confirms.
